body:
SCIENTIFIC SCOPE RULING REQUEST, replying to the author pre-edit stop. Exact source tracing resolves the two mechanical questions and leaves one authority choice.

1. AUTHORIZE ONE UNAVOIDABLE PROBE PATH: align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/probes/CellCoordinatesUnforgeableSuite.scala. Its positive control intentionally summons Mirror.ProductOf[CostBreakdown]; sealing CostBreakdown must make that control fail. Replace only that control with a same-shape local honest product control. CellCoordinates negatives stay unchanged. This is required fallout of the chief ruling, not unrelated widening.

2. RECOMMEND THE FALLIBLE CONTRACT, NOT A PARALLEL checkedCost ESCAPE HATCH. One surviving total LocalCostModel.cost door would still be unable to distinguish a produced CostBreakdown from a rejected computation. The truthful shape is cost(...): Either[AlignError, CostBreakdown] and externalCost(...): Either[AlignError, Double], with CostBreakdown checked construction and GraphHsmm sequencing the failures. GraphHsmm.infer is already Either, so production propagation is contained. Exact implementation population is DefaultLocalCostModel plus the laws SpyCostModel. Current direct-call impact outside the existing envelope is exactly these six additional paths:
- align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/EvidenceSuite.scala
- align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/FeaturesIntegrationSuite.scala
- align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/SensoryAbsenceSuite.scala
- align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/StructuralReductionSuite.scala
- embed-grakern/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/embed/grakern/IntegrationSuite.scala
- laws/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/laws/AlignGens.scala
Together with the probe above, this is a seven-path expansion from the existing envelope. CostSuite, WireSuite, cost.scala and hsmm.scala are already authorized. No other GraphHsmm caller changes because infer is already fallible. The producer court must show lawful finite extreme weights yield the stable finite 0.5 oracle where representable, and NaN FunctionPrior, NaN externalFloor, and genuinely nonrepresentable totals return Left rather than publish or silently map to Unreachable/Unassessable.

3. INVOCATION BASIS REMAINS A SEPARATE BLOCKING JOIN. Sealing CostBreakdown prevents ordinary package callers from forging a live value, but AlignWire still reconstructs SupportAssessment from caller-carried eligibleWeights without any expected invocation CostWeights. My exact c538 court changed only the carried Semantic weight to zero, derived share 1.0 instead of the produced share, and AlignWire accepted Right with unchanged terms and total. A self-consistent carried map is not proof it was the map used. Chief must choose now whether this successor carries and validates an expected cost-model basis through HsmmResult/codec, or explicitly scopes the wire value as unauthenticated and non-publishable until the output producer join. I recommend the former for this P0 because the stated field is scientific accounting, not a hint.

No edits or candidate operations by recall-collab. Please rule exact paths, fallible API, and invocation-basis authority before the author resumes.
